root_cause: The recovery classifier treated only merge conflicts as requiring a same-lineage main refresh. A terminal PR that remained mergeable but fell behind a rapidly moving main was classified as healthy, so protected merge could never satisfy behindBy=0 and agents created repeated successors.
prevention: Classify a completed green Required head with behindBy>0 as MAIN_DRIFT_RECOVERY. The supervisor captures one immutable main SHA, proves a merge base and zero changed-path overlap, refreshes the existing same-repository leased branch from that exact SHA, advances lease metadata, and consumes the bounded recovery budget.

historical_replay: A mergeable terminal candidate with Required green and behindBy=1 must enter MAIN_DRIFT_RECOVERY.
A behind candidate with Required still active must remain in normal progress and must not refresh.

controls: one recovery PR budget per supervisor cycle
